subject: math
title: Add Three Numbers
about: Short stories that add three numbers with a total of 20 or less. The trick NC wants is to spot two numbers that make ten (or a double) and add those first.
tip: Ask "do any two of these make ten?" before he adds in order.

cards.q: Kim has 4 red, 5 blue and 6 green cubes. How many cubes?
Jo picked 3 apples, 4 pears and 7 plums. How many fruits?
A box has 2 red, 8 blue and 5 green pens. How many pens?
Max saw 6 ducks, 4 geese and 6 swans. How many birds?
Ana has 5 cats, 5 dogs and 3 fish. How many pets?
Sam read 7 books, then 3 more, then 2 more. How many books?
Eli has 1 big, 9 small and 4 round rocks. How many rocks?
Mia has 6 pink, 2 white and 8 blue shells. How many shells?
The jar has 3 red, 3 green and 9 blue beads. How many beads?
Leo found 2 feathers, 5 buttons and 5 marbles. How many things?
Dad put 4 forks, 4 spoons and 4 cups on the table. How many things?
Zoe drew 9 suns, 1 moon and 10 stars. How many drawings?
